svg.title: Urban Liquor Litein database ERD
svg.desc: Entity relationship diagram for staff, products, stock movements, suppliers, supplier receipts, sales, sale items, and payments.
svg.text: Current application schema • primary keys, foreign keys, unique fields, and nullable fields shown
• A product has many stock movements and may appear in many sale items.
• A sale has many sale items and payment records.
• Sales have no staff_id foreign key; supplier receipts record the receiving staff member.
• stock_movements.reference_id is generic metadata, not a declared foreign key.
Wholesale shop deliveries and account payments
Separate from counter sales; each delivery stores agreed prices, reduces stock, and can be paid over time.
Wholesale sale items also reference products; created_by_id references staff. Delivery prices are saved per sale line.
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · UQ = unique · NULL = nullable · UQ* = unique with supplier_id · 1 to 0..* = one-to-many
